title: How to keep the spark after years together

slides.title: How to keep the spark *after years together*
Try *something new* together
slides.body: New is the fastest way back to “us.”

slides.title: Flirt like it’s *the beginning*
slides.body: Compliments, notes, a wink across the room.

slides.title: Plan dates *on purpose*
slides.body: Put them in the calendar. Then protect them.

slides.title: Touch *for no reason*
slides.body: A hand on their back as you pass by.

slides.title: Talk about *more than logistics*
slides.body: Ban “who’s picking up what” for one night.
